verdict.rationale: stagewise does run coding agents locally on the developer's machine: it is a standalone desktop IDE (docs-1, docs-24), agents can run shell commands (docs-18, docs-25), self-hosted models are supported (docs-3), and a community member notes agents run directly on the host (comm-8). The terminal side is barely evidenced: a single community comment says sign-up is only possible via a CLI (comm-11), which implies a CLI exists but not that it launches or drives the agent. The primary documented interface is a GUI desktop app. Missing for 10: documented CLI or terminal command to launch and interact with the agent, terminal-based agent workflow docs, hands-on corroboration of terminal usage.
